purpose: Frozen, independently resolvable release identities for the distribution/release surface. TT-S4EXT-001 / F001 exists because a single hand-copied `tag commit` string let the distributed pack name a DIFFERENT release's object than the one it claimed to describe. The two facts are therefore separate fields and must never be collapsed again.

field_semantics.tag_object: the annotated tag object sha (git rev-parse <tag>)
field_semantics.release_tag_target: the commit the annotated tag dereferences to (git rev-parse <tag>^{commit})
field_semantics.build_source_commit: the commit the distributed artifact BYTES were built from; when a release builds more than one artifact this names the one given by that entry's build_source_scope, and it is never a claim about an artifact the scope does not name
field_semantics.published_asset_sha256: sha256 of the asset bytes as served by the GitHub release

releases.superseded_candidate_note: produced on the repair branch as a separate corrected rebuild; NOT shipped, because the in-place correction was taken instead; this file is therefore not expected to exist on this branch

releases.served_assets_coverage: all 7 assets of the release are listed. SHA256SUMS lists 6 entries and does not list itself: 6 of 6 of those entries are represented here, and the seventh record here is SHA256SUMS itself.
releases.build_source_scope: the wheel pipd_ls_sp-0.1.1a4-py3-none-any.whl, whose build input is recorded as `build_input_commit` in dist/WHEEL_MANIFEST.json inside the release's own source archive. This field is NOT evidence about how the plugin ZIP pipd-ls-sp-public-skills.zip was produced; no such provenance is claimed by this entry.
releases.asset_list_source: SHA256SUMS asset of the release; every digest recomputed from the downloaded bytes 2026-10-16. PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md.sha256 is named by SHA256SUMS but by no other sidecar, so it is listed here explicitly rather than inferred.
releases.note: The release ships no mount pack: pack_dir/zip are null on purpose. published_asset_sha256 names the private skills-only plugin ZIP because that is the distribution surface this entry exists to pin (published_asset_name); every other served asset is in served_assets.

authority_note: This file records identity facts and the current disposition. It grants nothing: it is not a publication approval, a release admission, a tag move or an asset replacement. Reconciliation performed 2026-10-12 by the S4POST integration-repair round: the FIRST SHIPPED v0.1.1-preview.3 web ZIP carried the preview.2 object in all eight documents at digest 73c6c7e2...; the published asset was subsequently replaced in place under the S4R2M release correction and now serves af342d28..., which is the byte-identical artifact checked in under dist/mount with an agreeing sidecar and which rebuilds byte-for-byte from the current tree. What is NOT closed and belongs to the Release Owner: the immutable v0.1.1-preview.3 TAG still holds the pre-correction pack, so a rebuild from the TAG's tree does not reproduce the currently served asset; closing that needs a new immutable preview, not another in-place replacement.
